title: What Scripture Actually Says About Your Body (It's Not Vanity)
caption:
Most guys only hear 1 Corinthians 6 when someone's talking about lust. Paul meant more than that.

Your sleep, your food, your training, the way you treat the one body God gave you. None of it is vanity, and none of it is yours to waste. The church guy who lives on four hours and energy drinks and the gym guy whose mood depends on the mirror are making the same mistake from opposite ends.

Pick one bodily no this week and keep it. Save this for the morning you want to skip.

#faith #godlyman #discipline #stewardship
theme: He runs his life — his impulses don't control him.
